visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of a woman with long, wavy brown hair, wearing a white button-down shirt and a pearl necklace with a heart pendant. She stands in front of a shop with a prominent yellow sign containing red and blue text. Her facial expression is lively and smiling as she speaks directly to the camera. (2) A close-up shot transitions to a large metal wok in a kitchen environment. A hand holding a metal ladle stirs yellow noodles and green vegetables vigorously over a high-flame stove. Steam rises from the wok, and a large metal tin of barbecue sauce is visible in the foreground. (3) The scene shifts back to the woman in the same outdoor setting, now gesturing with her hands as she explains the history of the food stall. She maintains eye contact with the lens, showing high engagement through her expressive facial movements. (4) The woman is now indoors, sitting on a gray couch in a living room. In the background, a man is sitting and looking at his smartphone. On a coffee table in front of her are two large bowls of takeout food: one containing stir-fried noodles with meat and vegetables, and another with a dark herbal soup. (5) Several extreme close-up shots show the woman using wooden chopsticks to lift large portions of the noodles to her mouth. She chews enthusiastically, closing her eyes and nodding to indicate satisfaction. (6) The woman continues her review, looking into the camera while occasionally glancing at the food. She brings her hands to her chest in a gesture of emotional delight. (7) Close-up shots focus on her using a white ceramic spoon to sip the dark brown broth. She exhales with a look of relief and pleasure after each sip. (8) A macro shot shows a piece of mutton being lifted from the soup, highlighting its texture and the steam rising from the hot liquid. (9) The man in the background finally puts down his phone and leans forward to start eating from the same bowls. He takes a large bite of the noodles and gives a thumbs-up gesture. (10) The video concludes with the woman and the man leaning in close to the camera, both smiling and looking directly at the viewer as the review ends.

The creator combines an on-site introduction with an at-home tasting review to emphasize the quality and nostalgic appeal of the dish, while also providing practical information like the address and unusual opening hours to encourage viewers to visit.
